# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `lark-base` MCP server pointing at `https://api.cursor.com/rest-mcp/lark-base/mcp`.
- Declared required `CLIENT_ID` (App ID) and `CLIENT_SECRET` (App Secret) team variables. A team admin sets one Lark app that every member signs in under. Requires Cursor 3.19.0 or later.
- Logo: Lark's official bird mark, from the `larksuite` GitHub organization (Lark Technologies Pte. Ltd.).
